2126353779352293466.en_summary: $SPCX Bloomberg says Anterix could be SpaceX's next spectrum deal. Anterix is the largest holder of 900 MHz licenses in the U.S., and SpaceX has signaled it wants that band as it expands direct-to-device satellite service and moves toward becoming a full mobile carrier. SpaceX told the FCC in an Aug 10 ex parte letter that 900 MHz broadband licenses should be allowed to meet buildout rules through satellite D2D, not just towers. Anterix publicly backed that proposal the next day.
2126353779352293466.zh_summary: $SPCX 彭博社表示 Anterix 可能是 SpaceX 的下一個頻譜交易。Anterix 是美國 900 MHz 許可的最大持有者，SpaceX 已表示希望獲得該頻段，以擴展直接到設備衛星服務並向成為完整移動運營商邁進。SpaceX 在 8 月 10 日的單方信函中告訴 FCC，900 MHz 寬頻許可應允許通過衛星 D2D 而不是僅通過塔樓來滿足建設規則。Anterix 第二天公開支持該提案。
